title: Upgrade portable library contract to version 2
summary: Add language-aware two/four core outputs, witnessed reconstruction/source mapping, deterministic offline Persian reading HTML, and append-only activity memory in the same default master spreadsheet.
outcome: Synthetic offline pipeline/state tests and independent Review/QA rechecks passed; real local Chromium desktop/mobile and every page of the two-page sample print were reviewed. Final bundle test evidence is in evidence/upgrade-v2-validation.json. No live account, scheduler, real book, message or remote publication changed. Cloud capture remains pending because work is local and unpushed.
decisions: Use 2.0.0 for the breaking output/config contract; keep schema versions distinct.
Use a small witnessed reconstruction model, not a universal PDF parser or an extra translation pass.
Keep catalog plus shared operational memory/events in the same default Google Sheets file; preserve existing rows and use additive migration.
Use a central writer, stable event IDs, private durable outbox and destination readback; do not treat Sheets as an atomic distributed lock.
Treat products as optional runtimes and alternative destinations as capability contracts, without pretending all adapters are implemented.
next_actions: After separately authorized publication or package transfer, let the installed agent follow docs/UPGRADE-2-FA.md on its own account with TEST fixtures.
Verify live Sheets event/memory writes and active-version readback before claiming the existing installation upgraded.
Keep real books and private execution records out of the public repository; verify cloud capture separately.
